name: Censys
tagline: Internet-wide scan data for hosts, certificates, and services used in attack-surface research
description: Censys provides internet-wide scan data covering hosts, certificates, and services for attack-surface research and security analysis. The API enables searching and retrieving detailed information about internet-connected assets.

auth.details: API ID and Secret via Basic Auth or headers, self-serve signup

use_cases: lookup host details by IP address
find services exposed on the internet
research attack surface for an organization
